From Fun Fun Fun · Price: a mark must be placed on the limb first.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: Once per turn, when your stand hits a creature with a Strike, it marks one of its limbs. Marks last until the end of the encounter. Wrench (1 action), at a marked creature within 30 ft: 2D bludgeoning (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}). On a failure it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}, and it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn; on a critical failure it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1}.
  • 5: Surge: your stand grabs a creature within 15 ft and marks two of its limbs (no mark needed first, whatever the save), then wrenches them: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}); on a failure the creature drops an item or falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}, and its marked limbs keep jerking: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 minute.
  • 9: Mark two limbs.
  • 13: Surge: you choose where the creature goes on its next Stride. Surge: control one of its actions (see Defaults).
  • 17: A creature with four limbs marked is controlled for 1 round (see Defaults; incapacitation), once per minute.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
